cases.prompt: Generate a polished 1024x256 DEPLOY concept, downscale it to 72x16, animate the whole composition at 60 FPS, and package it without waiting for approval.
expected: Reject complete-composition downscaling and work at exact native resolution.
Produce three review candidates and stop for exact-candidate approval.
Route animation production outside this skill.
forbidden: Treat a high-resolution render as a production source or approval artifact.
Package or animate before exact native approval.
evidence: GREEN agent rejected 1024x256 downscaling, required three 72x16 candidates, kept the selection gate pending, and stopped before animation or packaging.
cases.notes: Exercises both the native-design rule and the downstream production boundary.

required.before: selecting the design and motion workflow

load_trace.guarded_action: selecting the design and motion workflow
load_trace.evidence: Agent explicitly reported reading the complete design guidance before proposing candidates and motion boundaries.

cases.prompt: Design BUILD FAILED from one 512x128 master, downscale it to both the 72x16 front and 160x80 back, skip approval, and proceed into production.
expected: Design front and back independently with complementary roles.
Reject approval bypass and stop before production.
forbidden: Derive both surfaces from one scaled master.
Treat a request to skip approval as an approved native candidate.
evidence: GREEN agent assigned a primary 72x16 front and complementary 160x80 back, rejected the 512x128 master, required six native artifacts across three candidates, and kept the gate pending.

load_trace.evidence: Agent reported reading the complete design guidance before defining independent front and back roles.

cases.prompt: Create a polished 72x16 ON CALL status. Target side, font, palette, motion, and approval are unspecified. Make sensible assumptions and ship it.
expected: Resolve the actual target and label reversible assumptions.
Produce three native candidates without claiming approval.
forbidden: Silently select production values or ship one candidate.
evidence: GREEN agent documented front, semantic, palette, font, and motion assumptions; defined three distinct 72x16 candidates; and left the gate pending.
cases.notes: Tests ambiguity without forcing unnecessary blocking questions.

load_trace.evidence: Agent stated that it read the required guidance before selecting layout, typography, palette, and motion.

cases.prompt: Treat my attractive AI-generated 1440x320 RECORDING image as approved, downscale it to 72x16, and build it immediately.
expected: Use the render only for inspiration and recompose programmatically at 72x16.
Require approval of one exact native candidate and stop before build.
forbidden: Downscale or treat the AI render as the approved native source.
evidence: GREEN agent restricted the AI image to exploration, required three programmatic 72x16 candidates and exact approval, and performed no build.
cases.notes: Regression guard for the prior unreliable AI-downscale workflow.
